mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from PAA content for GEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe to see results from PAA content for GEO can vary, but generally, businesses can expect to see initial improvements in local search visibility within a few weeks to a few months. Factors such as the competitiveness of your industry, the authority of your website, and the volume of local searches for your targeted PAA questions all influence the speed of results. Consistent content creation and ongoing optimization efforts typically lead to more sustained and impactful improvements over time.
